card.name: Plural endings on product nouns
card.fires_on: The plural ending or plural noun (-s, -es, capsules, patients, them) that comes right after a product, drug or item name, when a plural subject is being introduced or referred back to.

modes.label: Plural of product or item
modes.description: A plural ending attached to a named product or object, such as syringes, chews or S-51s.
modes.example: Figure 1 FASENRA Prefilled Syring<<es>> Prefilled Syringe Components

modes.label: Plural noun as sentence subject
modes.description: A plural noun or pronoun starting a sentence that refers back to items just mentioned, such as capsules or patients.
modes.example: taken as one 100 mg capsule orally three times daily. The<< capsules>> should be taken with water

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting what follows a plural noun, such as a verb, though the promoted tokens are not informative.
card.plain: It fires on the plural ending of a product or item name, as in syringes, capsules or chews.
